description:
Get one-time upload links for files in your sandbox or workspace, when you
can run shell commands with network access (Claude Code, Codex, a code
sandbox). One token PER FILE: a token uploads exactly one file. For several
files set count (1..20) to get that many descriptors in one call. Each
descriptor has a curl line: run it where the file is (replace <path>); it
prints a receipt with a fileRef. Then call mcpParse, mcpConvert or
editDocument with that fileRef. Tokens work once, for 10 minutes.
If curl fails with a network error, or the user wants to pick a file,
call uploadDocument instead, or ask for an https:// link. Never parse the
file yourself.
name: createUpload
title: Create upload link
